About this character artwork

Move gently near the selected turtle to invite curiosity. Tap a turtle to select it; tap open water to offer an inspection point. On the focused canvas, use arrow keys to place a guide, Enter to inspect, and Escape to clear it.

A NOTE ON THE MOVEMENT

A flipper stroke has an aftermath.

Watch for the quieter glide between efforts: a slight bank, an inspection, a measured return to the passage. Roles change the intention; depth and spacing change how the group reads.

Original procedural geometry, built on the integrated turtle study. Stylized behavior and scene timing; this is an artwork, not a biological simulation.
